## `core`

The interfaces every mod may import, on both sides.

| | Interface |
| --- | --- |
| import | `types` |
| import | `host` |
| import | `log` |
| import | `players` |
| import | `events` |
| import | `commands` |
| import | `scheduler` |
| import | `storage` |
| import | `services` |
| import | `channels` |
| import | `content` |

## `server-mod`

A server mod (`[entry] server` in `mod.toml`). Runs in the dedicated server or the host of a local world.

| | Interface |
| --- | --- |
| include | `core` |
| export | `guest` |

## `client-mod`

A client mod (`[entry] client`). Runs in the game client (PC port or Android loader). It gets the core imports (player-join, player-quit and kicks are server-only, and `players` lists the players the client knows about) and, since 0.3, `ui` for the HUD, toasts and dialogs. Other client interfaces (input, rendering, assets) come later.

| | Interface |
| --- | --- |
| include | `core` |
| import | `ui` |
| export | `guest` |
